physical_instance.reason: The model covariance has not been identified by hash.

full_output_extent.reason: All target output positions are represented; counts alone do not identify the circuit.

measurement_alphabet.reason: Declared detector alphabet matches; calibrated response is a separate gate.

imperfections.reason: Feature names are present, but their calibration is not bound to the target instance.

implementation_capacity.reason: The declared mode limit permits this extent; this does not predict runtime or quality.

distribution_quality.reason: Local validation does not establish quality for an unbound or different Jiuzhang target.
distribution_quality.next_action: First bind the physical instance, full extent, detector alphabet and imperfections; then validate that same law.

sampling_protocol.reason: The run is failed, incomplete, planned, or lacks completion metadata.

resource_timing_comparability.reason: Complete timing boundaries and resource measurements are missing or invalid.
resource_timing_comparability.next_action: Measure setup, sampling, complete wall time, threads/accelerators and peak memory under one documented protocol.

scale.dense_memory_note: One dense real 2m-by-2m covariance only; excludes copies, complex validation, workspaces and sampling state.

limitations: No scalar readiness score or defeat-of-Jiuzhang conclusion is produced.
Model equivalence and empirical hardware agreement are separate targets.
Observed maximum clicks are not mean/typical event hardness or a full-distribution quality certificate.
The checker trusts curated hashes and supplied validation records; it does not establish their truth by assertion.
